name: FrameFix
description: Practice tool: corrects early clicks and releases using a hidden trajectory predictor.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
practice-only.description: Only correct inputs while in practice mode. Strongly recommended.

click-max-frames.name: Max Early Click (frames)
click-max-frames.description: How many frames early a click can be and still get delayed into a success. 0 = off.

release-max-frames.name: Max Early Release (frames)
release-max-frames.description: How many frames early a release can be and still get extended. 0 = off.

random-mode.name: Random Mode
random-mode.description: Only some inputs get corrected, so you can't rely on it.
